title: Source Access Registry
description: Machine-readable, default-deny source access registry for ADR-0005 runtime case discovery. An unregistered domain is blocked. Status determines the maximum allowed access level; automated access requires explicit allowed_api_endpoints, allowed_methods, and allowed_operations. Media use always requires separate per-item license or human confirmation.

Openverse API at api.openverse.org (separate from openverse.org web domain). Registration as api_allowed enables metadata search only via the REST API at /v1/; each result's individual license must be checked before media use. Attribution requirements vary by source and license.

Wikimedia Commons API at /w/api.php is the sole allowed access point. Each file must be individually checked for license compatibility and attribution before any use. MediaWiki API etiquette requires serial (not parallel) requests.

Europeana REST API at api.europeana.eu (separate from europeana.eu web domain). CC0 metadata via /record/v2/ endpoint. Preview/media items carry individual rights statements that must be checked per item.
Smithsonian Open Access API at api.si.edu (separate from si.edu web domain). Only assets explicitly marked as CC0/Open Access may be used. API key registration required for higher rate limits.

Library of Congress JSON/YAML API accessed via ?fo=json parameter on loc.gov paths. Endpoints limited to /search/, /collections/, and /item/ path prefixes. Rights vary per item; many historical items are public domain but each must be individually checked.
NPS Developer API at developer.nps.gov (separate from nps.gov web domain). API key required. U.S. government works are public domain; third-party content on NPS sites may carry separate restrictions.

The Met Collection API at collectionapi.metmuseum.org (separate from metmuseum.org web domain). CC0 metadata and open-access images for public-domain artworks. Each item's Open Access status must be individually verified through the API.

V&A Collections API at api.vam.ac.uk (separate from vam.ac.uk web domain). Rights vary per item; some images carry CC BY or similar open licenses while others are restricted. Each item must be individually checked.
Art Institute of Chicago Public API at api.artic.edu (separate from artic.edu web domain). CC0 data for public-domain works. Open-access images require individual confirmation through the API.

CRITICAL: openstreetmap.org is the project/content domain (ODbL attribution target). The actual API host is overpass-api.de — a separate domain. Do NOT scrape openstreetmap.org web pages. Only spatial queries via Overpass API at overpass-api.de/api/interpreter are authorized. Attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors.

NOAA weather data via api.weather.gov (separate dedicated API host from noaa.gov). U.S. government work in the public domain. Use for site climate/weather/environmental context only. Data is informational, not regulatory.

USGS seismic/geological data via earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/ (precise API endpoint, not the usgs.gov web domain). U.S. government work in the public domain. Informational only, not a substitute for site-specific geotechnical investigation.

ASLA is a landscape-architecture source. Registered as future_scope per ADR-0005 §3 and the product roadmap §4. This does not activate standalone landscape workflows; those require explicit human confirmation, a separate Accepted ADR, and a roadmap update. No access of any kind is authorized until that occurs.
Landezine is a landscape-architecture publication. Registered as future_scope only. No access authorized until landscape scope is activated through a separate ADR and roadmap update.

Dezeen covers architecture, interiors, and design. Per ADR-0005 §3, Dezeen is not blanket-allowed and requires an explicit registry decision before automated extraction. Currently blocked until a separate review determines its status. Interior-design content must be treated as future_scope even if the domain is later registered for architectural content.

Architonic is an architecture and design product database. Per ADR-0005 §3, it is not blanket-allowed and requires an explicit registry decision before automated extraction. Currently blocked until a separate review.
